headline_assertion_text: Both with-library engagements produce >= 1 firm_library citation.

runs.brief: Generate a target screen for a UK retail-sector acquisition target with €100–500M revenue. Focus on omnichannel readiness and operational efficiency.
runs.recommendation_preview: Accept UK retail targets in the €100–500M revenue range if they meet ALL of: (a) cost-to-serve per channel demonstrably below sector median with documented channel P&L decomposition, (b) private-label program contributing measurable gross margin advantage with 3-year trend data, (c) 12-month customer cohort retention above sector median for last 3 cohorts with cohort-level data, (d) positioned as scaled omnichannel operator OR specialist single-channel player with named diffe

runs.brief: Develop a 3-year growth strategy for a regional UK retailer entering the US market. Cover entry mode options, market attractiveness, and risk profile.
runs.recommendation_preview: Enter the US market via acquisition of a regional grocer in the Mid-Atlantic corridor (Pennsylvania-Maryland-Virginia MSAs) or Upper Midwest (Wisconsin-Minnesota-Iowa cluster), targeting a £100m–£200m revenue asset with demonstrated omnichannel capability (≥15% digital sales penetration, <£8 cost-to-serve for online orders), followed by a 12-month integration phase with defined gates: achieve target's baseline omnichannel KPIs within 6 months, implement private label program
